cortes2017_matched_histories.locator: Cortes et al., supporting information, Fig. S4a, printed p. S-15. Approximate plateau readings from the two traces through 90 min.
cortes2017_matched_histories.observable: Concentration of Fe(II)Hₓ(Tar)₂ inferred from 720 nm absorbance. The signal combines protonation states. Tar is 4-(2-thiazolylazo)resorcinol.
cortes2017_matched_histories.limits: The traces approach the plateau by about 15–20 min. Figure S4a provides no endpoint sampling errors, replicate count or figure-specific temperature. Free iron and individual microscopic occupancies were unmeasured. No affinity was taken from either trace.

spicer1952_atp_acidification.locator: Spicer, Fig. 2 and accompanying text, JBC 199, p. 304. Magnesium salt was added to 2.5 mM ATP and solution pH decreased.
spicer1952_atp_acidification.limits: The plot gives neither measured free Mg nor proton equivalents needed to hold pH fixed. A temperature for this titration could not be verified.
